items.content:
Realised last week I haven't opened the lentil-soup link in months. I don't
make it from the recipe anymore, I make it from having made it — and the
recipe, which taught me, is now just a thing I keep out of loyalty. That's
the whole arc of learning anything, compressed into a soup.

summary: The soup made from memory now; the link kept out of loyalty
title: I stopped following the recipe
